clips.title: The story
paras: Raising Spirits is a Horde quest aimed at rekindling the fighting will of Gor'mul, a broken warrior consumed by despair. An emissary delivers a Raptor Talon Amulet in hopes of awakening the fierce spirit he once possessed. However, Gor'mul remains bitter, questioning whether any simple trinket could ever mend his sorrow or restore glory to the Horde.

Raising Spirits involves delivering a Raptor Talon Amulet to an orc named Gor'mul. His allies hope that the wild strength and ferocity of raptors, channeled through the talisman, will reawaken the warrior's flame that once burned fiercely within his veins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What hope is there when the hand of a coward can slay the mightiest of the mightiest? What hope, I ask you!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What is this? Polished bone. What use have I for polished bone? Will a trinket restore the Horde to its glory?
